verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a customer data platform could plausibly surface AI-generated insights, but no evidence shows Segment generating insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The only AI reference is a one-line pricing tagline, "Build AI‑powered audiences" (segment-docs-37). That describes audience building, an adjacent feature, not insights or suggestions. The Profile API "recommendation engine" example is a developer building block, and the "Open in ChatGPT/Claude" links point readers' docs to external tools, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
